collection.title: Peugeot Partner 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Peugeot Partner 2018 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. BOSCH recommendation is 26" & 17". The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment.
